|gr1= Camera Control

|arg= local

|eff= local

|descr= Set the zoom level ('''F'''ield '''O'''f '''V'''iew) of the given camera.
<br>
The zoom level is from ''{{hl|0.01}}'' for the nearest and ''{{hl|8.5}}'' for the furthest zoom value, with a default zoom level of ''{{hl|0.75}}''
<br>
The angle of the field of view is ''{{hl|atan(FOV)*2}}'' radians when in 4:3 aspect ratio. Needs the call of [[camCommit]] to be conducted.

|s1= camera [[camSetFov]] level

|p1= camera: [[Object]] - object of type "camera"

|p2= level: [[Number]] - zoom level, range 0.01 to 8.5 (see description above)

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_cam camSetFov 0.75;</sqf>

|seealso= [[camPrepareFov]] [[camSetFovRange]] [[camSetTarget]]
